name: Quake Live (PQL / Turbo)

scale.why: Quake III's hull (56 u tall, as the VQL entry), scaled to 1.8 m: 0.03214 m/u

jump.source: https://pastebin.com/zJ6XqCNq (line 431: pmove_JumpVelocity 275; the PQL bundle doesn't change it: https://github.com/Kr3m/QuakeLive/blob/master/src/code/game/bg_pmove.c#L169-178)

ground_accel.note: Quake accelerate factor (CPM's 15 instead of VQL's 10); the reconstruction and the player's config agree

friction.note: walk friction 6; holding forward + strafe on the ground uses pmove_CircleStrafeFriction 5.5 instead

stop_speed.note: not a Quake Live cvar; assumed unchanged from Quake III (the reconstruction keeps 100)

air_accel.note: PQL air with only a strafe key held: accel 70 toward 35 u/s (CPM's 70 toward 30). With forward held it is pmove_AirAccel 1.1 toward 320 u/s plus CPM air control 150. Same formula as Quark's (accel x min(wish, cap)); Quark multiplies air_accel by 10, so 70 -> 7.

air_cap.note: the wish speed the air push aims at

grapple.note: the grappling hook is a factory option, not standard play

airAccelForward.note: the air accel with forward held (Quake III shape, toward 320 u/s)

airControl.source: https://github.com/Kr3m/QuakeLive/blob/master/src/code/game/bg_pmove.c#L170 (airControl 150); https://github.com/Kr3m/QuakeLive/blob/master/src/code/game/bg_pmove.c#L751 (k = 32 x aircontrol x dot^2 x frametime)

airStopAccel.note: the air accel when the wish direction opposes your velocity

timeTo90.source: derived from this file's speed, ground_accel, friction, stop_speed
timeTo90.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; stop speed assumed from Quake III; Quark: 0.072 s

stopDistance.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopDistance.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; stop speed assumed from Quake III; Quark: 1.21 m

stopTime.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopTime.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; stop speed assumed from Quake III; Quark: 0.364 s

extras: CPM-style air control (150) and A/D strafe acceleration (70 toward 35 u/s)
air steps (3), ramp jumps, crouch slide
the VQL entry's chain / step jumps and auto-hop
notes: PQL, Quake Live's CPM-like ruleset (the default race and vampiric CA factories): pmove_AirControl 1 switches in a hard-coded bundle (air control 150, air accel 1.1, air stop accel 2.5, circle-strafe friction 5.5, strafe accel 70, walk accel 15, air steps 3, wish speed 35). Read from Kr3m/QuakeLive (a reconstruction of the retail code from the binaries) and matched by a player's saved config from a PQL server; gravity, speed, jump and step are VQL's, unchanged by the bundle.

sources.title: A player's Quake Live config from a PQL server (Danmer/ql-configs, QuakeCon 2015)
